import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    print('===',col)

    d = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16')
    base = piv.loc[[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-15'), pd.Timestamp('2025-10-09'), pd.Timestamp('2025-10-02')]].mean()
    delta = piv.loc[d] - base
    print(pd.DataFrame({'on_1016':piv.loc[d],'prev':piv.loc[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-15')],'base':base,'delta':delta}).sort_values('delta', ascending=False).head(10).to_string())

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
p = df.pivot_table(index='dt', columns='instance_family', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
hist = p.loc[:'2025-10-15']
# robust z using all history
med = hist.median(); mad = (hist-med).abs().median()*1.4826
z = (p.loc['2025-10-16']-med)/mad.replace(0,np.nan)
out = pd.DataFrame({'cost':p.loc['2025-10-16'],'hist_med':med,'hist_mean':hist.mean(),'hist_max':hist.max(),'mad':mad,'z':z})
print(out.sort_values('z',ascending=False).head(10).to_string())
print()
# same-weekday history for fG8wYOz6XO & g9c1yzr6KG Thursdays
thurs = p[p.index.dayofweek==3]
print(thurs[['fG8wYOz6XO','g9c1yzr6KG']].to_string())
print()
# check prices constant & no missing/extra rows on 10/16
day = df[df['dt']=='2025-10-16']
print('rows on 10/16:', len(day), 'unique fams', day['instance_family'].nunique())
print(day[day['instance_family'].isin(['fG8wYOz6XO','g9c1yzr6KG'])].to_string())

steps.content:
Root-cause findings, computed from `data.csv`:

- Cost = `price × num_instances × 24`; prices are constant for every `instance_family`, so the anomaly must come from instance counts.
- The account total on 2025-10-16 (Thu) is $3,943.63 vs $3,250.81 on the prior Thursday — dominated by AWS / `wpLAB` / app `qnK`.
- Drilling to the leaf resource dimension, `instance_family` `fG8wYOz6XO` jumped to **18 instances / $453.60**, versus 7–11 instances ($176.40–$302.40) on every prior Thursday (max 12 on any Wed/Thu/Fri) and 12 on 10/15.
